name: YOU?!

stats.behavior: Floats toward the nearest player at 3.4 u/s; within 10 u, a corrupted rumble 1.5 s, then a shockwave ring expands 9 u/s to 14 u (1.0 u tall, 0.6 u thick, plane of its feet). Hit = kill. Touch = kill.
stats.counter_play: Jump as the ring reaches you (jump height > 1.0 u from 0.10 s to 0.65 s), or stand >= 1.5 u above or below its feet.
stats.tell: A corrupted rumble ~1.5 s before every shockwave

behavior: Floats toward the nearest player at 3.4 u/s; within 10 u, a corrupted rumble 1.5 s, then a shockwave ring expands 9 u/s to 14 u (1.0 u tall, 0.6 u thick, plane of its feet). Hit = kill. Touch = kill.
counter_play: jump as the ring reaches you (jump height > 1.0 u from 0.10 s to 0.65 s — a 0.56 s window for a 0.16 s crossing), or stand ≥ 1.5 u above or below its feet. Under Echo Ring: jump 0.25–0.65 s before the first ring and jump again on landing — hard but learnable.
